edits.previous: | `Checked records and closed Nat indices` | `Generated record struct with BigUint and Vec<BigUint> payload fields; also carries the tested proof-free inherited Span, Ticket and Stamped record chain with nested parent subobjects preserved; also carries the tested proof-free recursive Packet and Envelope/Step graphs with nominal identities and active variants preserved` (input, result); `Generated Rust Packet with BigUint digit and word fields nested inside Holder and Choice::Packet; no proof field; also carries the tested proof-free inherited Span, Ticket and Stamped record chain with nested parent subobjects preserved; also carries the tested proof-free recursive Packet and Envelope/Step graphs with nominal identities and active variants preserved` (field) | Ordinary source: Installed checks passed (input, result, field); Not audited (callback input, callback result). The tested Rust Packet carries a Fin 10 digit and a checked Nat Subtype word as num_bigint::BigUint values. Holder nests Packet, and Choice::Packet carries it in the active Choice branch. Generated Rust adapters apply the exact Packet and nested Word constructors selected at each direct, repeated, Array, List, Option, tuple, Result, Holder and Choice input site. Rejected calls preserve the complete caller graph and later valid calls recover. Packet arrays and options returned by Lean contain proof-free payloads without input-constructor selections. The tested Span, Ticket and Stamped inheritance chain remains a chain of nested parent subobjects rather than flattened fields. Generated adapters preserve the parent aliases and public nominal identities, erase the ordered, linked and stamped proof fields, apply the exact per-site Span, Word, Ticket and Stamped constructors in dependency order, retain independent choices for repeated parameters, check the nested Fin 8 mark, preserve rejected caller values and recover on the next valid call. Full packages check inputs and proof-free results; result-only packages project the same inherited payloads without input-constructor metadata. The tested checked-record graphs preserve nominal identity through a self-recursive Packet and a mutually recursive Envelope ↔ Step pair, including aliases, Array and Option wrappers, active variant branches, exact Nat Subtype constructors and Fin 3 fields. Generated adapters validate every selected input site in dependency order, erase proof fields, expose constructor-free copied results, preserve rejected caller graphs and recover on the next valid call. Required: Construct inputs only through the selected safe Lean constructor over the exact payload fields. Preserve closed indices and per-site choices; project proof-backed results without fabricating proofs. |
